name: Algebraic Triad Collision
description: Replaces the global equality with a localized constraint on edges: a "compliance triad" generated by three functions (Sum, Product, Square of Maximum) which algebraically guarantee a collision (duplicate values) if and only if the two inputs are equal. This prevents models from using a lookup table's constant offset to bypass reasoning, forcing them to analyze the algebraic properties of the triad to discover it maps to 3-coloring.
